cases.name: action snapshots its atoms before waiting
cases.document:
kernel 1
numbers by_spelling
import 0 operation host.echo(value: Int) -> Int
definition "function child(value: Any) -> Any\nkernel 1\nmetering statements\nimport 0 operation host.echo(value: Int) -> Int\nbody {\n  print value\n  let answer = perform 0(value) as Int\n  print answer\n  return answer\n}\n"
main {
  let x = 1
  let h = spawn invoke child(x)
  set x = 2
  let answer = join h
  finish answer
}
